name: Couple Breaker
storyline:
“If you had the chance to get revenge on your cheating ex… would you take it?”
Taerin Yang, who had it all—until betrayal shattered her world. Now, she’s stepping into the spotlight on a reality romance game show to get back at her cheating ex. But there's a twist—she'll need a partner. Teaming up with her rival, Ju-a Gong’s ex, the two begin a fake relationship for revenge—but sparks start flying. Taerin’s heart and loyalty are tested.
Can you achieve the perfect revenge? Or will you fall for true love along the way?
summary: A female-oriented otome game based on a popular Naver webtoon comic, blending the intensity of romance, revenge, and reality dating show drama. Kisses, betrayal, and sweet revenge. Choose your path and explore multiple romantic endings. Immerse yourself in a world where every choice changes your fate
